name: S no Scenario
source:
Hero has a friend who is a good-looking and nice guy.
And he has been regarded his friend with envy.

One day, the hero seizes a chance and decides to violate his friend's sister.

The sister, humiliated, tells her brother's weak point as demanded.

This is a story where the body and the soul are raped at the same time.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044605.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
英雄有一个英俊善良的朋友，却一直嫉妒他。某天，英雄抓住机会，决定侵犯朋友的妹妹。

遭受羞辱的妹妹按照要求说出了哥哥的弱点。

这是一个身体与灵魂同时遭到强暴的故事。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044605.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
